businesses.business: industrial MRO and specialty products distribution

offering_description.value: Distributes maintenance, repair and operations (MRO) products, fasteners and other industrial supplies to industrial, commercial and vehicle-aftermarket customers. It also provides value-added services such as inventory management, kitting and tool repair. It operates through three platforms: Lawson, TestEquity and Gexpro Services.

primary_products.value: MRO supplies; fasteners and C-parts; electronic test and measurement equipment; cutting tools and abrasives; automotive and vehicle repair supplies

primary_services.value: vendor-managed inventory; supply chain and kitting services; tool and equipment calibration and repair; engineering and quality assurance support

customer_segment.value: B2B: industrial manufacturers, aerospace and defense, electronics, utilities, vehicle repair shops and MRO buyers; B2G: government and defense-related customers buying supplies and test equipment

end_markets.value: industrial manufacturing; aerospace and defense; electronics; automotive aftermarket; utilities and energy

revenue_model.value: product sales: MRO supplies, fasteners and test equipment sold to customers; service fees: inventory management, kitting, calibration and repair services

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys products from many manufacturers and resells to industrial, commercial and OEM customers; service provider: supply chain, inventory management and calibration services for customers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Mexico, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: MRO supplies, high-volume fastener supply, and test and measurement equipment distribution

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: field sales representatives and key account teams; online: e-commerce websites and catalogs; own locations: distribution centers and branches; other: inside sales and telesales
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; online; own locations; other

regulatory_exposure.value: low: General commercial rules, plus some trade, customs and defense-contractor quality requirements
